<!--
This body is never rendered into the card — the social-card template uses only
the metadata above — so it's the natural place to document how the card works.
-->

## What this file is

This defines the site's social card (the preview image shown when a link is
shared). Edit the `title`, `subtitle`, and `image` in the front matter above.
Colors and fonts come from `_brand.yml`; to override them for just this card,
add a `brand:` block to the front matter (it *replaces* the project brand, so
respecify fonts too).

## Generating the PNG

```bash
quarto render _thumbnail.qmd
quarto typst compile _thumbnail.typ thumbnail.png --font-path .quarto/typst/fonts --ppi 144
```

`thumbnail.png` is a 1200×630 card. It's already wired into `_quarto.yml` as
`website: image:`, so the site uses it as the default `og:image`. Re-run these
two commands whenever the title, subtitle, image, or brand changes.
